column5: I think that the race distance (5k, 10k, marathon) filter should be included in the initial section before you click search, rather than becoming available afterwards.
I think that you should label the map nodes with the name of the race so that you know where the specific races are taking place.
I thought the placeholder for the Zip code was already written in so I clicked on search without inputting anything. Other than that the app was fast
The map wasn't as easy to find, I kept looking for it in the race information.
